column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for operation and maintenance record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the equipment. FK to Equipment.EQUIP_CODE.
REAL. Total operational hours of the equipment. Example: 17843.
REAL. Maintenance cycle hours. **NULL means no maintenance cycle defined.**. Example: 2047.0.
DATE. Date of the last maintenance. **NULL means no maintenance date provided.**. Example: 25-Feb-24.
DATE. Date of the next scheduled maintenance. **NULL means no next maintenance date provided.**. Example: 2025/11/16.
TEXT. Operational status of the equipment. Possible values: Active, Maintenance, Repair, Standby, Storage.
REAL. Maintenance cost in USD. Example: 7632.51.
REAL. Repair cost in USD. Example: 3297.13.
REAL. Operating cost in USD. **NULL means no operating cost recorded.**. Example: 338.79.
TEXT. Certification status of the crew. Possible values: Expired, Pending, Valid.
TEXT. Inspection status of the equipment. Possible values: Failed, Passed, Pending.
TEXT. Compliance state of the equipment. **NULL means no compliance state recorded.**. Possible values: Compliant, Non-compliant, Review.
TEXT. Documentation status for the equipment. Possible values: Complete, Incomplete, Updated.
BIGINT. Optional reference to communication link.
